decisionsTitle: «Spune-ne ceva»: one anonymous wizard — how it was, a suggestion, a complaint, and a confidential safety form that reaches one person (amending §149, §445)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-08, in five messages:** «I want another thing on the contact page, below the newsletter, I want a button for an anonymous feedback form page, where people can select an event (via query params so I can reuse it later for after the event), a date, and what happened and we send it via Gmail (configurable) this way we know why people stopped coming. And also we need a suggestion box. But also a rating. IDK make something up, I just want to know how my runners are feeling» — «The anonymous feedback feature on the contact page must be a toggle (feature flag)» — «Also on the contact form I want to have a "ladies only" complaint, cuz we had issues with ladies not feeling safe so we must have an anonymous ladies only form that gets to [one named organizer] only» — «So basically I need to have a wizard about the type of complaint/feedback» — «But I wanna reuse the same feedback form for the main events as well».

**Decision.** One door on `/contact`, under the newsletter box (§445): a section «Spune-ne ceva» / "Tell us something" (`#spune-ne`) with one button to one page, `/contact/spune-ne` (`/contact/tell-us`). The page is a server-rendered wizard with no client state beyond the form. Step 1 «Despre ce e vorba?» is a `GET` form — native radios, one per branch switched on, and «Continuă» — so the branch is `?tip=` in the address and the back button works; exactly one branch on skips the step; none on, or a privacy notice in force that does not describe the forms, draws no door and answers 404.

Four branches, **each off by default**, each switched on in «Pagini» → «Contact» → «Spune-ne ceva» with the one address that receives it (setting `feedbackForms`, one `platform_settings` row, no table, no migration; everybody who reads content reads it, `canManageClubSettings` writes it; audited as which branch moved and in which direction, which recipient changed and whether the safety name did — never an address or a name):

- **«Cum a fost»** (`cum-a-fost`) — one form for every kind of event, races and group runs alike: an event picker (published events, the last 90 days and the next 30, the held ones first, the most recent first, then the ones ahead, plus «Altceva / în general»), preselected by `?eveniment=<slug>` and `?data=YYYY-MM-DD` — an unknown or unpublished slug simply leaves «Altceva» selected —; a rating as five faces (native radios with MUI's sentiment glyphs, labelled); «Ce s-a întâmplat?» (required, 2 000 characters); «Dacă nu mai vii, ne spui de ce?» (the hour or the day, the place, the group's pace, an injury or health, I moved, other, and one line); an optional email for an answer.
- **«O sugestie»** (`sugestie`) — one box and an optional email.
- **«O reclamație»** (`reclamatie`) — what happened, the same optional event and date, an optional email.
- **«Siguranță»** (`siguranta`) — confidential, for women who did not feel safe: what happened, an optional where-and-when line, an optional «Dacă vrei să te contacteze {name}, lasă un email sau un telefon». Above the form, in the person's language: «Mesajul ajunge doar la {name}. Site-ul nu păstrează nimic din el.» — {name} is the first name the club set (1–40 characters), never a name in code.

**Two roads.** The three ordinary branches leave the contact form's way (§149): the club's Gmail over SMTP (`contactSmtpRoad`, the transport of `contact/delivery.ts`), at once, to the branch's one recipient with no copies, `Reply-To` the address typed when one was typed, marked «[posibil spam]» on §310's signals. **The safety branch leaves by Mailgun alone** — the environment's sender with no Gmail road, which captures on a laptop and in the tests — never `enqueueEmail`, never an outbox row, with a neutral subject («Mesaj confidențial de pe site»), no `Reply-To` (`OutgoingEmail.noReplyTo`, which the Mailgun adapter honours) and Mailgun's tracking off (every Mailgun send, §320), the contact line in the body only. Why Mailgun alone: a Gmail send leaves a copy in the shared mailbox's Sent folder, the opposite of «only {name}»; and there is no fallback — Mailgun refusing or not answering brings the form back with «Nu am putut trimite acum. Încearcă din nou în câteva minute.» and the text kept in the sealed draft cookie (§142), never a silent loss and never a second road.

**Anonymous means anonymous.** No row anywhere: no table, no outbox row, no audit of content; the function log says the branch and the outcome only (`[feedback] safety: sent`). The IP goes to Cloudflare with the Turnstile token and nowhere else (AGENTS.md §19.4). The email is the fields the person filled, in the form's order, in Romanian for the club with the form's language on its own line, and «(fără contact lăsat)» when no way back was left; `[QA] ` on QA (§163).

**The gates, in the contact form's order.** The branch must be offered; Cloudflare's `failed` is the one Turnstile verdict that refuses (§216), with the text kept; the fields; the honeypot and the timing check (`looksLikeSpam`, now given the typed address so a password manager's autofill is not a bot, §282) answer «trimis» with nothing sent on the three ordinary branches — and on the safety branch the neutral «Nu am putut trimite acum…» with the text kept, because a lost report costs more than a bot's sentence; then one bucket per branch an hour (`RATE_LIMITS.feedback`, thirty, keyed on the branch's name — the forms are anonymous, so there is no identity to key on), said plainly «Prea multe mesaje în ultima oră; încearcă mai târziu.»; a send the road refused gives its attempt back.

**The notice.** The privacy notice's template says in section 5, in both languages, that the forms are anonymous unless a contact is left, that the site keeps nothing, that the messages reach the club's mailbox (Gmail) — the safety form only the designated person's own address, through the club's email service (Mailgun, EU) —, that they are kept as ordinary correspondence for at most 12 months and a safety report as long as it takes to deal with it, and that a report naming another person is treated confidentially and used only to handle the matter (art. 6(1)(f) GDPR); section 10's cookie sentence names the forms too. The marker `{{feedbackForms}}` («Spune-ne ceva», quoted) is the gate, the newsletter's shape (§445): the door and the page exist only while the notice in force names it in every language (`describesFeedbackForms`, `cachedFeedbackFormsDescribed`). A branch switched on under a silent notice is a row on `/admin/tasks` (`feedbackNotice`) and a warning on the panel, never a door and never a 500. The moved template is announced to the Administrators by §639's email, by itself.

**Three ways in, while «Cum a fost» is open.** `EVENT_THANKS` carries «Spune-ne cum a fost» with the event and its day filled in — the button when the thank-you has no results link, a link under the results button otherwise — read at send time from the setting and the notice, like every fact of a message. The public event page shows the same button once the event is over (completed, or past its end), under the line that says so. `ORGANIZER_MESSAGE` gains `{feedbackLink}` (in the closed set, §247, but filled only in that message): the form for the message's event while «Cum a fost» is open, the contact page otherwise; the composer's help and the «Emailuri» legend say so. It is the one address in the closed set, and it may be because the platform mints it from `APP_BASE_URL` exactly as it mints the button's — nobody types it.

**Refused.** Storing the messages for a backoffice list: the owner asked for email, and a stored complaint is personal data the notice would have to carry and the club would have to erase. A «ladies only» check: nobody can verify it, and a man asking for help should not be refused — the branch's words address women, the door is open. Sending the safety branch through the club's Gmail: a Sent-folder copy in a shared mailbox is the opposite of «only {name}». A reply from the site: the recipient answers from their own mailbox when a contact was left.
changelogLine: - **«Spune-ne ceva» under the newsletter on Contact** — an anonymous wizard: how an event went (an event, a day, five faces, why someone stopped coming), a suggestion, a complaint, and a confidential «Siguranță» form for women that reaches one person by Mailgun alone; each branch switched on in «Pagini» → «Contact», nothing stored, the thank-you email, the event page after the end and the organizer's `{feedbackLink}` lead to it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Cum a fost» switched on with a recipient and the notice in force naming `{{feedbackForms}}` in both languages, when `/<locale>/contact/spune-ne?tip=cum-a-fost&eveniment=<slug>&data=YYYY-MM-DD` renders, then it offers the published events of the last 90 days and the next 30 with «Altceva / în general», the slug's event preselected (an unknown or unpublished slug leaves «Altceva»), the date, five faces, «Ce s-a întâmplat?» (required, 2 000 characters), the stopped-coming ticks and line and an optional email; a post sends one email through the contact form's SMTP road to that recipient alone, `Reply-To` only when an address was typed, marked «[posibil spam]» on §310's signals, with the fields in the form's order and «(fără contact lăsat)» when no contact was left (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «O sugestie» switched on, when a suggestion is posted, then one email «O sugestie de pe site» reaches the branch's recipient through the SMTP road, never Mailgun, and nothing is written to `email_outbox`, `audit_logs` or any other table (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «O reclamație» switched on, when a complaint is posted with or without an event and a date, then one email «O reclamație de pe site» reaches the branch's recipient through the SMTP road, naming the event or «altceva / în general» (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Siguranță» switched on with a recipient and a first name, when its form renders, then it says above the form «Mesajul ajunge doar la {name}. Site-ul nu păstrează nimic din el.» in the page's language; a post is sent through the environment's Mailgun sender alone — never the SMTP road, never the outbox — with the subject «Mesaj confidențial de pe site», no `Reply-To` and tracking off, the contact line in the body only; a Mailgun refusal, or a post that trips the trap or the timing check, comes back «Nu am putut trimite acum. Încearcă din nou în câteva minute.» with the text kept, and the sent page says only {name} received it (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Every branch is off by default; with none on, or with a privacy notice in force that does not name `{{feedbackForms}}` in every language, `/contact` draws no «Spune-ne ceva» section and the wizard answers 404; with one branch on, the wizard opens that branch's form without the choice. Each branch has its own bucket of thirty posts an hour, the thirty-first answered «Prea multe mesaje în ultima oră; încearcă mai târziu.»; the setting is written by the Administrator alone, refused when a branch is on without a recipient (or the safety branch without its first name), and audited without any address or name; `/admin/tasks` carries `feedbackNotice` while a branch is on and the notice is silent (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Cum a fost» open, when an `EVENT_THANKS` renders, then it carries «Spune-ne cum a fost» to `/contact/spune-ne?tip=cum-a-fost&eveniment=<slug>&data=<the event's day>` — its button when the thank-you has no results link, a link under the results button otherwise — and nothing of the kind while the branch is closed; the public event page shows the same button once the event is completed or past its end (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an `ORGANIZER_MESSAGE` whose words name `{feedbackLink}`, when it renders, then each half reads «Spune-ne cum a fost» for the message's event in its own language while «Cum a fost» is open, and the contact page's address otherwise; the composer's help names the field (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: one anonymous wizard from Contact, the safety form reaching one person
